gloss: to pass through; to transit; to go through

definitions.gloss: to pass through (a place); to go past without stopping
definitions.explanation: To move through or past a location without stopping there. Commonly used for trains passing through stations, vehicles passing through areas, or storms passing over regions.

definitions.gloss: to pass (a test, inspection, or legislative process)
definitions.explanation: To successfully get through a review, screening, or approval process.

notes:
A versatile verb with both physical (passing through a place) and abstract (passing a screening) meanings. Very common in news, train announcements, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{通過|つうか}{駅|えき}→通過駅：25116_tsuukaeki⟧: a station the train passes through
- ⟦{通過|つうか}{点|てん}→通過点：24887_tsuukaten⟧: a passing point; a milestone
- ⟦{通過|つうか}{儀礼|ぎれい}→通過儀礼：24879_tsuukagirei⟧: rite of passage
- ⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通過|つうか}する: to pass a screening
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通過|つうか}する: to pass through parliament

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to pass / to go through — more general and casual; used in everyday speech
- ⟦{通|つう}じる→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧: to lead to / to be understood — focuses on connection or communication
- ⟦{経由|けいゆ}→経由：02791_keiyu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go via / to transit through — emphasizes the route taken

USAGE:
On Japanese trains, station announcements frequently say ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〇〇⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通過|つうか}します to warn passengers that the express train won't stop at certain stations.
